name: Principe Forte dei Marmi
positioning: Independent contemporary hotel in the beach town of Forte dei Marmi on the Versilia coast, with a Michelin-starred restaurant, a rooftop lounge and a contemporary art program
best_for: Food lovers who want a Michelin-starred restaurant in the hotel
Couples and families on a Versilia beach holiday who also want a spa, a garden pool and outings like the marble quarries

facts.text: Principe Forte dei Marmi is set in a landscape of palm and pine trees in Forte dei Marmi.
Rooms have a minimal design with exclusively Made in Italy furniture and accessories.
The Principe restaurant has a large window onto the garden and pool area and serves international cuisine.
The outdoor pool has an area with Balinese tents, deck chairs and a pool bar.
The hotel's private spa experience includes an indoor heated pool, a whirlpool, a Finnish sauna, a bio sauna, a Turkish bath and an ice cascade.
For children and teens, the hotel offers private tennis and golf lessons, guided bike tours and children's pastry workshops.
The hotel's experiences include visits to the marble quarries.
Works by sculptor Romolo Del Deo are displayed on the hotel's panoramic rooftop.
Open Space suites have floor-to-ceiling French windows overlooking the garden and the Apuan Alps.

highlights.text: Lux Lucis is home to the Michelin-starred cuisine of Chef Valentino Cassanelli.
The 67 Sky Lounge is on the hotel's panoramic rooftop, overlooking the Versilia coast.
The hotel offers a 24-meter Mazarin yacht with a flybridge and three cabins.
The Arte al Principe project centers on marble and granite sculptures by Korean artist Park Eun-Sun.
Dalmazia restaurant is framed by large verandas with a view of the beach and the open sea.

considerations.text: The outdoor pool and pool bar open seasonally, from April to October.
Conde Nast Traveler describes the hotel as set a block back from the boardwalk.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's exclusive positioning.
